marketed_identity: Trans-Tek / manufacturing associate of Applied Audio
model_or_product: Applied Big Fuzz and other amplifier/effects production
evidence_summary: A June 1968 trade report documents a new South Plainfield New Jersey factory for Trans-Tek Manufacturing Company, previously of Garwood, operating with Applied Audio as an associate organization. The same report says workers would build amplifiers and effects, explicitly naming the Applied Big Fuzz. Current historical research uses this evidence to explain how Applied Audio could support a broad OEM network. Preserve Trans-Tek as a manufacturing associate/production organization pending evidence for independently marketed Trans-Tek pedal models; do not merge it into Applied Audio.
